verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a REST/SDK video API product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of versioned API endpoints or a formal deprecation policy. The changelog note that Video remains a standalone product, and the community discussion of a shutdown announcement, concern product continuity, not a documented API versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
